title: A Superfast Direct Solver for 2D Type-II Inverse Nonuniform Discrete Fourier Transform Based on Hierarchically Semiseparable Matrices
summary: Reconstructing images on Cartesian grids from nonuniform Fourier samples is a basic computational task in Fourier reconstruction methods for computed tomography. This paper proposes a direct solver for the 2D type-II nonuniform discrete Fourier transform~(NUDFT) based on the face-splitting product of hierarchically semiseparable~(HSS) matrices. We define the face-splitting product of two HSS trees and prove that the face-splitting product of two HSS matrices admits an HSS representation on the resulting tree.
